title: Vector merge: incremental fold (avoid full layer re-arrangement per stroke on dense art)
description: Follow-up from P5 cutover (task 1323). RESOLVED via spatial bbox-culling in engine/planar/merge.ts (foldShapeIntoLayerCulled): planarMergeCommit now folds ONLY the mergeable shapes whose stage-space bbox overlaps (within 1px tol) the incoming stroke through the kernel; disjoint shapes are kept UNTOUCHED as their own display objects (layer may hold several merged shapes). Correctness exact: a disjoint shape contributes no crossing edges so cannot change any face the stroke touches, and a non-interacting shape is an identity through the kernel = merged artwork equals full rebuild. Touching-edge shapes kept in by tolerance so coincident-edge unions still see both sides. BEFORE/AFTER per-stroke fold (median of 5, stroke overlaps few fills): 100 ~28ms->0.4ms, 400 ~79ms->1ms, 800 ~214ms->0.8ms, 1000 ~239ms->2ms (target <50ms). A stroke spanning the WHOLE layer still does the full ~216ms fold (work genuinely needed). VERIFY: all 8 merge-drawing oracles diff=0/220000 (correctness unchanged); core 5465 pass + authoring-ui 1013 pass + swf 1466 pass (only the 3 pre-existing task-1207 flash8-empty.fla-fixture files fail, env-only); pointer-stage 7/7 pass. New unit tests in planar-merge.test.ts (spatial-cull incremental fold: untouched-disjoint / culled==full-rebuild / touching-edge / PERF 500-fill bounded). Docs: docs/36 §3.0e + CLAUDE.md learning. Shell.tsx wiring unchanged (planarMergeCommit signature identical).
